# Website records: Saltmarsh Ferry café (fictional design-check fixture)

# Design

- authority_source: toolkit default (fixture)
- design_family: none
- selected_direction: calm estuary palette; pale ground, slate text, one teal accent for actions
- semantic_tokens: --color-ground: #f7f5ef, --color-surface: #fff, --color-ink: #1f2a30, --color-muted: #4d5b63, --color-accent: #0f5c6e, --color-accent-ink: #ffffff, --color-focus: #b4400a, --space-1..3, --radius-1: 4px, --duration-short: 120ms, --font-body: system-ui, sans-serif
- type_rules: system UI stack; body 1rem/1.6; headings 1.15; labels may track at 0.08em
- layout_rules: single column, 65ch measure
- component_states: buttons have hover and focus-visible states
- responsive_intent: one column at every width
- motion_intent: 120ms colour transitions only

- attribution: none required (original work)
- crop_and_size: 120x60 viewBox, scales to the column width
- placement: / hero
- alt_text: Line drawing of a small ferry on the water
- status: approved
